text:
maria_sales: Hey team — Acme legal pinged about SIG/CAIQ + privacy overlap for the POC. They want to confirm DPA + SCCs are in place and how DSAR/deletion works. Can we consolidate answers for their vendor risk team?

ajay_se: I can drop the POC dataflow diagram and config for the POC infra. We used ephemeral buckets and `retain_for_days: 30` by default for session logs.

lena_security: Heads up — for Hosted API we don't persist customer input beyond 30 days by default; dedicated/private can change retention. For the POC we can set retention to 7 days or request deletion on demand.

oliver_legal: Quick legal note: DPA is standard. For cross-border transfers we'll attach SCCs (post‑2021/2022 standard). If Acme needs an addendum for EU data residency, we need to escalate.

sarah_acme: thx. one more Q — if a user files a DSAR, what's the exact path and timeline? We need to show our SOC team.

lena_security: DSAR flow: 1) request comes to privacy@redwood.com (or the Console webhook) 2) verify requestor (ID match) 3) search user identifiers across storage/ingest 4) export results + redact 5) deliver within 30 days (extendable). For deletion: trigger deletion job that removes KV caches, logs, and any persisted blobs.

maria_sales: can you paste the pseudo-command or snippet we give Acme? helps sales demos.

ajay_se: sure — here's the internal dev snippet we use for retention override in POC config:

```yaml
poc_config:
  mode: hosted
  retention_days: 7
  dsar_endpoint: https://company.example/console/dsar-hook
  delete_on_request: true
```

lena_security: Also share audit evidence: deletion job run logs + S3 lifecycle + access logs. We can point them to the Console trace for request IDs.

oliver_legal: For the vendor risk SIG answers — we should mark any control that is customer-configurable as "configurable by customer" and include remediation timelines. No surprises.

sarah_acme: are SCCs included in your standard DPA package or do we sign separately?

oliver_legal: SCCs are appended to the DPA as an exhibit. We'll include language about subprocessors and subprocessors list. If they need a tailored DPA, send details.

vendor-bot: Automated docs: SIG/CAIQ snapshot (redwood-2026-03) https://redwood.docs/vendor/security-snapshot-2026-03.pdf, DPA + SCC template https://redwood.docs/legal/dpa-sccs-2026.pdf

maria_sales: Perfect. Action items: (1) Ajay attach POC dataflow + snippet to the response (2) Lena produce short DSAR/deletion runbook + one example audit log (3) Oliver confirm DPA+SCC exhibit will be attached to the contract draft. I'll send consolidated packet to Acme vendor-risk by EOD.

lena_security: I'll add the runbook and sample log — make sure to redact identifiers.

ajay_se: Uploaded the dataflow PNG to the thread and pushed config to the POC workspace. Link: https://internal.redwood/poc/18653

sarah_acme: thanks all — that should cover the vendor risk team's checklist. I'll loop back if they want a live walkthrough. :thumbsup:

maria_sales: thanks team — I’ll follow up after the walkthrough.
